# Sample Wiki Home

This page exists so you can dry-run `migrate_wikijs.py` without
touching a real export.

- [Installation](/guides/installation)

title: Installation
description: How the sample project gets installed.
content:
# Installation

```bash
sudo apt update
sudo apt install sample-package
```

Note the `tags` field on this page uses the object form
(`{"tag": "..."}`) while the home page uses plain strings — real
Wiki.js exports contain both, and the script normalises them.

# Troubleshooting

This page is unpublished (`isPublished: false`) so you can confirm

| Symptom | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| Service will not start | Check the unit log |
